services.name: Sunfish Rental
services.desc: Get out on a Sunfish! Duration and Rates 1 Hour Rentals: $10 2 Hour Rentals: $20 Full Day Rentals (8 hours): $40 About Looking for a fun and easy way to explore the open water this summer? Look no further than the Sunfish! With its lightweight and easy-to-use design, the Sunfish is the perfect choice for both beginner and experienced sailors. Imagine yourself skimming across the surface of a sparkling lake or gliding through gentle coastal waves with nothing but the wind in your sail. The Sunfish offers a thrilling and unforgettable sailing experience that will have you hooked from the first moment you set sail. So why wait? Rent a Sunfish today and discover the joy of sailing for yourself!

services.name: 21' Hurricane Deck Boat Rental
services.desc: Grab a boat and get out on the Water! About The 21’ Deck boat with 150HP or 130HP outboard and sun bimini. More Info Persons desiring to rent the YP Deck Boat must be 21 years of age or older and possess either a Virginia Boaters Safety Card or an equivalent from another state. In lieu of the card, a prospective renter must complete a VA DGIF Safety Checklist at the time of rental which will be administered by YP Staff member that has a Boater’s Safety Card. All renters must at all times comply with all rules and regulations concerning boater safety in effect at the time of the rental. Note the renter, the Boater Safety identification, and the credit card holder must all be the same
